name: Fate of Emerging Contaminants in the Environment
description: Introduction to emerging contaminants, types of contaminants- pharmaceuticals, personal care products, nanomaterials, microplastics, per-polyfluoroalkyl substances, antimicrobial resistance; characteristics of contaminants, sources and pathways in the environment, point and non-point sources, persistence in the environment, abiotic and biotic transformations in water, air and soil media, biotransformation, sorption-desorption; influence of environmental conditions, governing factors; synergistic and antagonistic effects of mixture of ECs, uptake by plants and animals; bioaccumulation and biomagnification, toxicity, guidelines for regulating the release of ECs.
